correctness.rationale: Checked the rephrased normalized theorem: rate rescaling gives iid unit exponentials, squared profile mass is at most one, and the characteristic-function tail remainder is controlled by the next ranked coefficient times the tail squared mass. The Bernoulli series is an L²-bounded martingale. The local centered mass increment has variance O(s_n³), leaving deterministic slope 1−θ on the s_n scale; the exact strict-crossing event gives weak convergence even for atomic limits. Nonzero third cumulant, or negative fourth cumulant when θ=1/2, distinguishes every nonzero profile. Power-sum and zeta evaluation at the harmonic endpoint and the single-heavy-weight example follow from the displayed coefficients. No time-moment limit is inferred.
